FORCE half-screen difference: new adult woman with clearly different face shape/hair/age (not the same person as the reference, not a celebrity); rewrite headline to a new 2-line claim with different wording; warmer or cooler key light; different cheek highlight shape; slightly tighter or wider crop. FORBIDDEN: kitchens, interiors, renovations, products-only, full body, non-face subjects. No brand marks, watermarks, competitor logos, celebrity likeness.
